description: For every finite set \(F\) of natural indices in the family \(A_0=\{1,2,3,\ldots\}\), \(A_n=\{n\}\) for \(n>0\), choose \(f(n)=n\) for positive \(n\) in \(F\) and, when zero is present, \(f(0)=1+\max(F)\), with \(\max(\varnothing)=0\). This is an injective choice from the available sets on \(F\).
